title: Verify Dashboard Batch 1: Progress, Vocabulary, Wishlist
description: End-to-end verification including MOBILE-FIRST responsive testing at 375px and 1200px widths.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Login as etan@heyman.net (use Convex dashboard magic link)
Verify 'My Songs' section exists (may be empty initially)
Navigate to a song, practice a few lines by clicking them
Return to /dashboard - verify song appears in 'My Songs' with progress
Verify 'My Vocabulary' section shows practiced words grouped by language
Click to expand vocabulary section - verify words are listed
Go to song page, click wishlist/heart icon
Return to dashboard - verify song appears in 'My Learning Queue'
Remove from wishlist - verify it disappears from queue
MOBILE TEST: Resize browser to 375px width
MOBILE TEST: Take mobile screenshot - verify single column layout
MOBILE TEST: Verify no horizontal scroll, all content fits
MOBILE TEST: Verify touch targets are adequate (44px+)
MOBILE TEST: Test collapsible sections work on mobile
Check console for errors via mcp__browser-tools__getConsoleErrors
If ANY issues found: create US-DASH-FIX-* story with specific fix needed

blockedBy: Magic link authentication fails with INVALID_TOKEN error. Tokens are generated correctly but verification endpoint returns error. Likely a Better Auth configuration issue with token verification or CORS.
